approval.rationale: Top-down fine grey ash with evenly scattered black cinder specks and a few pale ash flakes; nothing in it is large enough to repeat at 4 m, so the Ash Steppe reads as one continuous burnt ground.
limitations: Close up it reads closer to speckled concrete than to loose ash: there are no wind ripples, drifts, clinker lumps or charred stems.
Very uniform: the steppe relies on roads, fields and meadow patches for variation.
The candidate is a bright blue-grey; the cook darkens and neutralises it.
